backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata file mapping implemented features to associated source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptions of key frontend files for documentation or tooling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind‑based global stylesheet defining the Valentine theme color tokens and base styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app with Valentine‑themed title and metadata.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling the prompt, evasive button logic, and celebration state UI.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverl: Component displaying animated fireworks, sparkles, and floating hearts during celebration.
frontend/src/config/valentineConfig.ts: Holds configurable text for site name, prompt, button labels, and celebration messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and managing authenticated or anonymous backend actors using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts: Hook calculating random safe positions for the evasive 'No' button within its container.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and hook managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and status.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme CSS variables, global styles, and custom Valentine-themed UI classes including layout, background image, and styled prompt/buttons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, sets up React Query and Internet Identity provider, and loads global styles before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended OKLCH color tokens, typography, animations, and custom theme settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature descriptions, image requirements, and notes about build issues for the Valentine’s website.
